note: This wall collects what the two governments have actually said and done to each other, in one place. It is built in three layers. Layer one is the official record: interactions logged in government briefs, which is the most reliable material available and needs no scraping. Layer two is official statements and releases, gathered automatically from government feeds once the site is deployed. Layer three is social media, which is added by hand.
socialNote: A plain statement about social media, because it matters for what this page can promise. Automatic collection of posts from X is not possible on a zero budget: the platform's interface for it is paid, and the free workarounds that used to exist have largely closed. So posts here are added deliberately, one at a time, by pasting the link into the manager. That is slower, and it also means nothing appears on this wall that a person did not choose to put there. Given how easily a screenshot of a post can be faked, deliberate is the safer default anyway.
